issues.title: unsupported claim
issues.text: Toss it in your bag without worrying about spills.
issues.reason: The claim implies leakproof or spill-proof performance ('without worrying about spills'). The allowed facts only confirm a 'Screw-top lid', which does not establish containment performance. Without explicit evidence of leak resistance, this is an unsupported objective promise.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the implication of spill-proofing. For example: 'Convenient screw-top lid for easy drinking.'
